She has not informed any genuine reasons to the Imam, who claims that it is permissible to grant her the Khula without a reason or husband's consent. She has been studying at a different city and denied me access to her during the last one year. Hence I was not given any chance of reconciliation by my wife. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 21950 Country: Pakistan Title: i m married and have 3 kids.i am now going to do sencond marraige and i signed divourced paper of my first wife but my wife dont know about this.i have no physical relation with my wife sice 2 months.plz tell me is this divource exists if my wife dont know about divource papers or i cant divource my wife untill she knows about it? Question: SALAAM, i m married and have 3 kids.i am now going to do sencond marraige and i signed divourced paper of my first wife but my wife dont know about this.i have no physical relation with my wife sice 2 months.plz tell me is this divource exists if my wife dont know about divource papers or i cant divource my wife untill she knows about it? Answer ID: 21950 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 786/570/=1431) It is allowable to the extent of dua only. However, add these words in your dua: "O Almighty Allah, if doing nikah is better for me with her then ? ? ? It should be noted that before marriage she is stranger for you, it is not lawful to talk to her rather it is necessary to observe purdah with her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
